name: relative-time-card
title: Relative Time Card
description: Activity rows each end in a live relative time such as one hour ago. Hovering one opens a card with the precise date and time in New York, London, Tokyo and the local offset.
use: An activity feed for a distributed team needs exact times and several zones without leaving the page.
avoid: It opens on hover with a delay, and the narrow card crowds long zone names and timestamps together.
a11y: The trigger is a real button with a focus ring and each zone row is labelled, but the card never checks reduced-motion settings. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A bordered dark list of four activity rows, each pairing a name and action on the left with a muted absolute timestamp on the right, above a View time details button. On hover a dark card floats over the list showing a relative line and four timezone rows tagged with small grey chips.
behaves: Hovering or focusing a timestamp opens the card after a short delay with the relative age and the exact time in each configured zone; moving away closes it. The ago label refreshes on a timer while the page is mounted.
customise: Pass date and a timezones array, pick a variant, and pass children to replace the trigger label. openDelay, closeDelay, updateInterval and the hover-card side and alignment are props too.
weight: light: One timestamp plus an interval that recomputes the relative label every second.
